Description:
Canadian International School (CDNIS) is an international school situated in the Hong Kong Island district of Hong Kong. It provides education spanning early years through secondary levels, following the Canadian Curriculum framework. The Canadian International School of Hong Kong (CDNIS) is a non-profit, fully authorised IB World School offering a “through-train” education to students aged 2 to 18. With approximately 1,800 students representing 41 nationalities CDNIS delivers the IB Primary Years, Middle Years and Diploma Programmes. The school is also authorised to grant credits towards the Ontario Secondary School Diploma. All G11 & 12 students are enrolled in both the IBDP and OSSD, graduating with two distinct diplomas. From PN - G1 (and every year thereafter until G5 in 28/29) the Early Years are delivered in both English and Mandarin. 50% of the class time is in English and 50% in Mandarin (on a 6 day cycle). Students will be immersed in the target language for the entire school day. The English and Chinese teachers will teach on alternate days. All classes will also have a bilingual educational assistant, who remains with the same class and switches language each day.

The new CDNIS Early Years Centre at The Southside opened in August 2024 is for all PN and EY1 classes (half day). From EY2, classes are at the main campus and are full day.

PN/EY1 half-day programmes (7:50-10:20am or 11:50am-2:20pm). From G1 - G5: Chinese is streamed; 280/mins a week until 28/19 when the bilingual track will be fully rolled up all the way to G5. From G6 onwards, at that point, all classes are delivered in English, except for Chinese.
